operationalLimitations.description: Responsive Web application certified for production across mobile & desktop browsers. Native mobile builds remain emulator-tested only; physical multi-device lab certification is deferred to post-GA mobile rollout.
Payment workflows operate in strict SANDBOX_ONLY mode. Partner disbursement payouts remain GATED. Real monetary clearing deferred to a dedicated commercial phase.
Internal xAPI event wrappers and SCORM runtime environments execute reliably. Certification against external third-party LRS endpoints and SCORM Cloud is deferred.
Validated safe operating limit is 2,500 concurrent Virtual Users per standard cluster deployment (p95 latency < 200ms). Workloads exceeding 3,000 VUs require horizontal replica scaling.
